meta.title: HaKorem Farms: fresh meat, eggs and live animals
meta.description: Fresh meat weighed to order, eggs by the crate, live animals and produce from HaKorem Farms in Ghana. Delivered to your door or collected from the farm.
meta.categoryDescription: {{category}} from HaKorem Farms, from the farm to your table.
meta.quoteRequestDescription: Buying eggs by the crate, live animals or meat in bulk? Tell HaKorem Farms what you need and we will send you a priced quote.

header.tagline: From the farm to your table

home.eyebrow: From our farm to your table
home.title: Fresh meat, eggs and live animals, straight from the farm
home.body: Meat cut and packed on the farm and weighed to order, eggs by the crate, live animals chosen with you, and fresh produce. Delivered to your door or collected from the farm.

how.title: How buying by weight works
how.oneBody: Meat is priced per kg. Each pack shows its usual weight, so you see an estimate before you pay.
how.twoTitle: We weigh it before it leaves
how.twoBody: Every pack is weighed on the farm's scale on the day it is sent.
how.threeTitle: You pay for what it weighs
how.threeBody: The checkout shows the most you can be charged. If a pack weighs less, you get the difference back.

weighed.title: Priced by weight
weighed.rule: Each pack is weighed before it is sent and you pay for the weighed amount. The checkout shows the estimate and the most you can be charged.

request.title: Live animals are sold by request
request.body: We choose the animal with you and agree its price before anything is paid. Asking online opens soon; until then, visit the farm or call the shop.
request.bodyWithContact: We choose the animal with you and agree its price before anything is paid. Asking online opens soon; until then, call or WhatsApp the shop, or visit the farm.

delivery.title: Delivery or collection
delivery.body: Choose delivery to your address or collection from the farm at checkout. The checkout shows the delivery fee and the days we can come.

refusals.REQUEST_TO_BUY_ONLY: Live animals are sold by request, so they cannot go in the basket.
refusals.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: This item cannot be bought online just now.

refusals.STOCK_UNAVAILABLE: There is not enough in stock for some items. Lower the quantity or remove them from the basket.

refusals.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: That delivery time cannot be booked any more. Choose another.

refusals.COUPON_UNAVAILABLE: That coupon cannot be used on this basket.
refusals.COUPON_ALREADY_APPLIED: A coupon is already applied. Remove it to use another.
refusals.NOT_FOUND: We could not find your basket. Start a new one from the shop.
refusals.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
refusals.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The checkout is busy. Wait a minute and try again.
refusals.NETWORK_ERROR: The shop could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

footer.label: Site
footer.about: HaKorem Farms. Livestock, meat and fresh produce from our farm in Ghana. HaKorem means the vinedresser, the farmer.
footer.buyingByWeight: Weighed items are priced per kg and charged on their weighed weight, never more than the most shown at checkout.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the product may no longer be in the shop.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page stopped working. Try again.

quoteRequest.title: Ask for a quote
quoteRequest.intro: Buying in bulk for a bakery, a kitchen, a chop bar or a shop? Tell us what you need and how many crates. We will call or message you with a priced quote, usually within one working day.
quoteRequest.name: Your name
quoteRequest.phoneHint: We call or WhatsApp you on this number. For example 024 451 2876.
quoteRequest.emailHint: Optional. For a copy of the quote by email.
quoteRequest.requirementsHint: For example: big eggs every Friday, or twenty goats of about 25 kg for a funeral.
quoteRequest.cratesHint: Optional. For eggs or produce sold by the crate. Leave it empty for anything else.
quoteRequest.neededByHint: Optional. The day you need it.
quoteRequest.deliveryAreaHint: Optional. The town or area we would deliver to, for example Kasoa.
quoteRequest.consent: You may call, message or WhatsApp me about this request
quoteRequest.consentHint: We use your number only for this request.

errors.title: Some details need correcting
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number we can call, for example 024 451 2876.
errors.email: Enter an email address like ama@example.com, or leave it empty.
errors.requirementsLong: Keep it under {{max}} characters. You have {{count}}.
errors.crates: Enter a whole number of crates, from 1, or leave it empty.
errors.neededBy: Choose a day from today on, or leave it empty.
errors.consent: Tick this so we may contact you about your request.

quoteRequest.rateLimited: Too many requests have come from this phone or connection in a short time. Wait a few minutes and send it again, or call the farm.
quoteRequest.doneBody: Keep this number. Quote it when you call us about this request.

quote.title: Quote {{quoteNo}}

issued.title: Do you accept this quote?
issued.body: Accept it to tell the farm to go ahead. We will call you to arrange the deposit and delivery.

quote.acceptedNameHint: Typed in place of a signature.
quote.acceptedNameMissing: Type your full name to accept.

confirmAccept.title: Accept quote {{quoteNo}}?
confirmAccept.body: You are accepting version {{versionNo}} for a total of {{total}}, as {{name}}.

confirmDecline.title: Decline quote {{quoteNo}}?
confirmDecline.body: The farm will be told you do not want version {{versionNo}}.
confirmDecline.reasonHint: For example: found it closer to home.

quote.refusedTitle: The quote could not be answered
quote.refusedBody: It may have expired or been replaced while it was open. Its state now is shown above.
quote.acceptedBody: Thank you. The farm has your acceptance and will call you to arrange the deposit and delivery.
quote.declinedBody: Thank you for letting us know. Ask for a new quote at any time.
quote.expiredBody: It was valid until {{when}} (Accra time), so it can no longer be accepted. Ask us for a new quote and we will price it again.
quote.supersededTitle: This quote was replaced by a newer version
quote.supersededBody: The farm changed the quote and sent you the new version by message. This link can no longer be used: open the newest link we sent you, or ask us to send it again.
quote.notFoundBody: Check that you opened the whole link from the message we sent. If it still does not open, ask the farm to send it again.
